container.title: Auralis
config.title: Auralis
config.mode: Connection mode. Auto prefers the local runtime, then the remote endpoint.
config.localEndpoint: Local runtime API endpoint. Loopback HTTP endpoints are allowed.
config.mcpEndpoint: Local MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint. Leave empty to derive it from the local endpoint.
config.remoteEndpoint: Remote control-plane endpoint. HTTPS is required.
config.remoteMcpEndpoint: Remote MCP endpoint. HTTPS is required.
config.locale: Extension UI language. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
config.personalSkills: Personal Skill directory. Empty uses the standard Copilot skills directory.
config.binary: Path or command for the hpa binary used by the explicit Start Local Runtime command.
config.startArgs: Arguments passed to the hpa binary by Start Local Runtime.
mcp.provider.name: Auralis Local MCP
